RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the August 17, 2007/Sravana 26, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small
and Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
26
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Stoppage of express trains at
Alamnagar station
†*81. SHRI BANWARI LAL
KANCHHAL: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that stoppage of
various express trains is very necessary at
Alamnagar railway station keeping in view
the increasing pressure of passenger traffic in
Lucknow alongwith the expansion of the city;
(b) whether a public movement is also
being carried on by various organizations
in this regard;
(c) whether Government in public
interest would consider the stoppage of
different express trains at Alamnagar station
in Lucknow; and
(d) if so, by when and if not the reasons
therefor?
Allocation of wheat under PDS
†*82. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 14.4 million
tonne wheat was allocated during the year
2006-07 under PDS and other welfare
schemes;
(b) if not, the quantity of the same;
(c) whether it is also a fact that out of
this allocated quantity only 10.3 million
tonne wheat was lifted;
(d) if not, the facts in this regard;
(e) whether it is also a fact that during
the month of June of the current year also,
the allocated quantity was not fully lifted;
and
(f) if so, what was the actual quantity
allocated and the total availability of wheat
in the Government godowns as on 1st July,
2007?
Production and procurement of wheat
†*83. SHRI UDAY PRATAP SINGH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the total production of
wheat and procurement thereof by
Government in the country during the year
2007, State-wise and what is the stock
available at present;

27
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether Government propose to
import wheat; and
(c) if so, the proposed quantity thereof
and the reasons for importing the same?
Package for jobless farmers in Assam
*84. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that due to heavy flood every year,
small and marginal farmers in Assam are
suffering serious economic setbacks and the
number of such farmers is huge;
(b) whether it is also a fact that number
of jobless farmers is increasing every year,
resulting in steep decline in agriculture/
foodgrain production; and
(c) if so, whether Government have any
scheme to extend financial package for the
hapless farmers?
Emergency prescription of allopathic
medicines by Ayurvedic doctors etc.
*85. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of  HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
consideration of Government to allow the
Ayurvedic Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani,
Siddha & Homoeopathy (AYUSH) doctors
to use the life saving drugs in emergency
which are normally prescribed by the
Allopathic doctors;
(b) whether any demand in this regard
has so far been made by the A YUSH
Medical Society; and
(c) if so, what is the reaction of
Government thereto?
Assessment of passenger traffic
requirements
*86. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA RAO:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Railways have assessed
the passenger traffic requirements of the
Hyderabad-Tirupathi and Hyderabad-
Visakhapatnam section for the year
2007-08 and projected figures for
2008-09;
(b) if so, what are the shortfalls in
present availability of passenger coaches
for the existing trains on the above two
sections respectively;
(c) whether Railways would correct and
rectify the chronic and extreme shortage of
passenger trains and passenger
accommodation through a mid-year review;
and
(d) what steps would be taken in the
short-term to increase trains in the
Hyderabad-Tirupathi and Hyderabad-
Visakhapatnam section in Andhra Pradesh
alongwith the details thereof?
Procurement of wheat
†*87. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) what was Government's target for
procurement of wheat from farmers and
the total quantity of wheat procured by
Government;

28
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) the quantity of wheat purchased by
private companies, particularly from the
wholesale markets of Punjab and
Haryana;
(c) what was the quantity of wheat
purchased by Government from the whole-
sale markets of Haryana and Punjab and
when it was purchased;
(d) what arrangement was made for
protecting the purchased wheat from rains
and when;
(e) the quantity of wheat which was
moistened due to rain occuring in June, 2007
and afterwards; and
(f) steps taken by Government to save
the moistened wheat from decaying?
BPL card holders
*88. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Planning Commission
issued orders stipulating the number of
BPL card holders in the States;
(b) if so the details thereof;
(c) whether such steps would keep large
number of deserving sections out of the
PDS benefits;
(d) whether Government received
representations from States to review the
decision; and
(e) if so, the details of the steps taken
by Government?
Vacancies in Railways
*89. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of posts lying vacant in
Railways, which are reserved for SC, ST
and OBC categories zonal Railways and
post-wise; and
(b) the reasons for such vacancies?
Testing facilities for spurious
drugs
*90. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether as per the report of World
Health Organization (WHO) 35 per cent
of drugs sold in the country are spurious;
(b) whether only seven laboratories are
functioning in the country to check drug
samples and if so, the action taken to set
up such laboratories in every State;
(c) whether there are about 11,000
chemist shops in Delhi and only 29 Drug
Inspectors to inspect these shops;
(d) the total number of drug samples
lifted from these shops during the last three
years and how many of them found to be
spurious; and
(e) the stringent measures taken by
Government to check availability of
spurious drugs in Delhi and other parts of
the country?
Fake medicines
†*91. PROF. RAM DEO
BHANDARY:
SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether information has been
received regarding availability of big
quantity of fake medicines in many States
of the country;

29
(b) if so, the details of raids, recovered
fake medicines, registered cases and arrests
made during the last six months, State-wise;
(c) whether Government intend to make
present law against criminals engaged in
the business of fake medicines more
stringent; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Corruption in PDS
†*92. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that foodgrains
allocated under the Public Distribution
System are not reaching the lower strata of
people and the poor and major part of the
same is directly reaching open market at
high prices through black market;
(b) whether Government are aware that
most of the foodgrains under this scheme
is going to big companies;
(c) whether Government are
contemplating any new scheme for
preventing this corruption prevalent in
PDS;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether it is a fact that PDS has
completely failed in the country and only
middlemen and big companies are its
beneficiaries; and
(f) if so, action taken by Government in
this regard?
Coverage under Crop Insurance
Scheme
*93. SHRIMATI JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the extent of coverage at
present in terms of States as well as
population under Crop Insurance Scheme;
(b) what has been the number of
beneficiaries and amount of benefit given
in the last one year, alongwith the details
thereof, State-wise; and
(c) whether there is any proposal to
extend the coverage of the scheme to more
States?
Malaria and Chikungunya
*94. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether malaria and chikungunya
have taken a heavy toll of life in certain
States of the country this year;
(b) if so, the details of the cases reported
and the death toll this year in the country,
State-wise; and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to control these diseases in future?
Funds for displaced fishermen of
Andhra Pradesh
*95. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the status of the National
Fishermen's Fund;
(b) the funds disbursed from this fund
during 2005-06;
(c) the funds proposed to be disbursed
during 2006-07;
(d) whether any fund has been released
for the displaced traditional fishermen of
Kolleru lake in Andhra Pradesh; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

30
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(e) whether any proposal has been
received from Andhra Pradesh Government
in this regard?
Increasing the frequency of trains
†*96. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
take any action for increasing the frequency
of the Jodhpur-Guwahati train for running
it three days a week instead of one day
being run at present; Jaipur-Bangaluru train
for running it four days a week instead of
two days being run at present; and Jaipur-
Chennai train for running it daily instead of
three days a week being run at present in
view of their long waiting lists and non-
availability of reservation for months
together; and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Production enhancement of fertilizers
†*97. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have fixed any
target for increasing the production capacity
of chemical fertilizers during the Eleventh
Plan in the country;
(b) if so, the details of the target;
(c) the number of projects having
additional production capacity likely to be
set up in the country to achieve this target;
and
(d) the total amount of capital required
to be invested for this purpose?
Shortage of fertilizers
*98. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
there are reports of shortage of fertilizers
in various States;
(b) whether Government are also aware
that delayed supply or created paucity of
fertilizers is adding fuel to fire;
(c) if so, whether Government are
considering to take necessary steps against
erring suppliers and transporters; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Kandla-Palanpur rail line
*99. SHRI KESHUBHAI S. PATEL:
SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is possible to convert the
route from Kandla to Palanpur as a part of
dedicated freight corridor between Delhi
and Mumbai;
(b) whether it is also technically
possible to provide such double stack
container arrangement alongwith
electrification on this route; and
(c) whether there is any proposal under
consideration for providing such double
stack facility in any other part of the
country?

31
Additional coaches in trains
*100. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have added more coaches with the
important mail/express trains to meet the
daily requirements of the public;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that a
coach has also been added to the Delhi-
Azamgarh Kaifiyat Express train keeping
in view the high demand of the public for
convenience; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons for discrimination with
Azamgarh?

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the August 17, 2007/Sravana 26, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare;  Micro,
Small and Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
137
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Scheme to implement PM's
declaration
†589. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Planning
Commission was given the responsibility
to formulate a scheme in order to
implement the declaration made by the
Prime Minister on May, 2007 for spending
rupees 25,000 crore for development of
agriculture sector;
(b) if not, the details thereof to whom
the above responsibility was attributed;
(c) the details of proposals relating to
the scheme received by Government until
now in this regard and from whom the same
were received by Government; and
(d) by when Government are likely to
finalise these schemes?
Election of societies under MSCS Act,
2002
590. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether as per the provisions of
MSCS Act, 2002, it is the responsibility of
Central Registrar of Co-operative Societies
to conduct election within a period of 90
days when such election became due in case
the society does not conduct the election
in time;
(b) if so, what action is taken against
the Central Registrar in case he does not
conduct elections of such societies; and
(c) the details of the societies where the
elections were not held as per schedule and
the details of action taken by Central
Registrar therein?
NAFED loans
591. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to refer to the answer to Unstarred
Question 1073 given in the Rajya Sabha on
the 2nd December, 2005 and state:

138
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) the details of persons, businessmen,
corporate houses, etc. to whom loans were
given by NAFED indicating the purpose
for which the loan was given together with
the quantum of loan given to each one during
2000—2004;
(b) whether the bye-laws of NAFED
permit to give loans to other than farmers
and whether the persons, etc. to whom
loans were given were entitled to receive
loan from NAFED and, if so, the details of
the rules and if not, the action Government
propose to take in the matter; and
(c) the quantum of loan recovered so
far, loan-wise?
Wheat production
†592. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that production
of wheat has declined constantly during
the last three years;
(b) if so, the total production of wheat
during this period; and
(c) the efforts made by Government
during the last three years to boost the
production of wheat and the extent of
success achieved by Government in these
efforts?
Biotechnology Coordination Board to
monitor GM crops
593. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have asked the States to set up State Level
Biotechnology Coordination Board to
monitor the GM crops;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons of, if any, delays from
the States in setting up of this panel;
(d) without setting up of this panel how
the Central Government is going ahead to
give sanction to GM crops in the respective
States; and
(e) in such cases who would be the
monitoring authority for the contamination
and other GM crop related problems?
Steps to dispose the weeds imported
with American wheat
†594. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of wheat in quintals
being imported by Government from
America this year;
(b) whether it is a fact that about 21
types of weeds are also likely to be
imported in India alongwith this imported
wheat and if so, the names of such weeds;
(c) the details regarding the harms which
are to be borne by the farmers of the country
in their next crops due to these weeds;
(d) whether Government are going to
take any effective steps to dispose of these
weeds; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not
the reasons therefor?
NAP stress on some crops
†595. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the
National Agriculture Policy all stress has
been laid on some crops like wheat, rice,

139
cotton, sugarcane and groundnut and no
attention has been given to eco-friendly
crops in the country; and
(b) the schemes formulated or under
consideration for development of good
quality seeds of these local crops, their
publicity, storage and distribution?
Convergence of technologies to
enhance productivity
596. SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
in an all India Seminar held in Nagpur during
January, 2007, a general consensus emerged
stressing upon the convergence of the
information computer and electronic
technologies with farming technology to
empower the farmers to enhance their
productivity; and
(b) if so, whether the Institutes of
Agriculture Research would be advised to
evolve simple modalities so that grassroot
farmers could be apprised and motivated
to adopt technologies?
Mechanism for protection against
losses from bird flu
597. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the outbreak of bird flu has
again been noticed in the country;
(b) if so, whether any steps have been
taken to contain its spread in to various
parts of the country and any compensation
mechanism has been devised to protect the
farmers from the imminent losses;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
National Bamboo Mission Programme
598. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) how far it is a fact that Government
are about to launch National Bamboo
Mission Programme after China's success;
(b) if so, whether this mission will be
able to generate employment opportunities
especially in Assam where the availability
of Bamboo is plenty;
(c) whether Government have
developed the necessary infrastructures to
fulfil the mission; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
National action plan for farmers
599. SHRI M. V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have chalked
out any national action plan for farmers of
the country to save them from drought/
floods/rising cost of inputs, etc.;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of financial allocation
made by Government for this purpose
during the current financial year 2007-08,
State-wise?
New initiatives in wheat policy
600. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a High Level Committee on

140
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Long Term Grain Policy of Government
(Abhijit Sen Committee) has stressed that
the nation embark on new initiatives in
wheat policy taking into consideration
increasing consumption thereof in the
country coupled with environmental
problems due to which its production per
hectare is declining; and
(b) if so, by when a new wheat policy
is likely to be evolved?
Farms deprived of modern science and
technology in M.P.
†601. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that most of the
farmers in Madhya Pradesh are deprived
of modern science and technology;
(b) whether the Government of
Madhya Pradesh has forwarded a proposal
of Rs. 2700 Lakhs to the Central
Government to provide sufficient scientific
and technical know-how to the farmers;
and
(c) if so, by when the said amount would
be provided to the Madhya Pradesh
Government?
PM's RKVY initiative
602. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Prime Minister has
announced a Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana
of Rs. 30,000 crores initiative to provide
incentives to various States for their better
farm performance; and
(b) the details of the scheme and the
modus-operandi of the financial
arrangement?
F.S.I. Boats
603. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA RAO:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Fishery Survey of India
is operating boats to study the availability
of marine resources in the Exclusive
Economic Zones (EEZs);
(b) if so, how many such boats are
operating;
(c) what are the annual fixed and
variable costs of operating and maintaining
such boats;
(d) whether any cost benefit study has
been done of the activities of the Fishery
Survey of India; and
(e) the steps proposed to review the
policies and utility of diverse objectives of
the F.S.I.?
Problems faced by chilly farmers of
Andhra Pradesh
604. SHRIMATI N. P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it has come to the notice of
his Ministry the problems being faced by
chilly farmers of Andhra Pradesh due to
non-getting of remunerative price for chilly;
(b) if so, whether it has also come to the
notice of his Ministry that in a matter of
45 days the price has fallen down from
Rs. 7,500 per quintal to Rs. 4,500 per
quintal; and
(c) what steps his Ministry is taking to
help the chilly farmers of Andhra Pradesh
and how it is planning to buy chillies from
them?

141
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Promotion of organic fertilizers
605. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
promote organic fertilizers by giving
subsidy and also market facilities; and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
PM's scheme for development of
agriculture sector
†606. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the month
of May, 2007 the Prime Minister had
announced a scheme of rupees 25,000
crores for expenditure under a new system
for the development of agriculture sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any effective action plan
has also been formulated in order to utilize
the above mentioned amount; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Rain based farming
†607. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the percentage of agricultural land
dependent on rains in the country;
(b) whether some concrete effort is
being made by his Ministry to encourage
rain-based dry farming in the State of
Uttarakhand; and
(c) if so, the details in this regard?
Terminal markets for agricultural
produces
608. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to set up terminal markets for agricultural
produces with the private/co-operative
sector participation in the country;
(b) if so, the details of their locations;
(c) the features thereof and the funds
released for the purpose; and
(d) when the said scheme is expected to
be implemented?
Foodgrains production in Bihar
†609. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the present position regarding
foodgrains production in Bihar; and
(b) the total quantum of foodgrains
required by Bihar at present and the total
requirement of foodgrains by the year 2020
keeping in view the increasing population
as a major factor?
Dairy development
†610. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is immense
potential in dairy development in the
country; and
(b) if so, the steps taken or proposed to
be taken by Government in this regard?

142
Purchase of wheat by FCI
†611. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that production
of wheat is over 74 crore tonnes this year;
(b) what was the target fixed for wheat
purchase by the Food Corporation of India
this year;
(c) whether that target has been
achieved;
(d) if so, the total quantity of wheat
purchased by the Food Corporation of
India; and
(e) if not, the reasons for less purchase
of wheat?
Production of paddy, pulses, etc.
†612. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
increase the production of paddy as well
as pulses and oil seeds in the country;
(b) whether Government are aware of
the fact that there is an acute shortage of
authentic seeds with State Seeds
Development Corporation in the State of
Chhattisgarh, as a result thereof SSDC is
not in a position to provide authentic seeds,
particularly paddy, Maize, Kodo, Kutaki,
Arhar, Soyabean, groundnut, horse-bean
and green-lentil in Rajnandgaon, Durg,
Kwardha, Korba, Janjgeer, Jashpur,
Sarguja, Bastar, Kanker and Koria Districts;
and
(c) if so, the steps taken by the Central
Government to provide required quantity
of authentic seeds to State Seeds
Development Corporation and the details
of the seeds which have been provided
together with the quantity thereof?
Low agricultural production in the
country
†613. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agricultural
production in the country is declining day
